info.description: Defines a subscription plan with pricing, billing, expiration, and access rules.

Title.description: The name of the subscription plan (e.g., 'Premium Plan').

Description.description: Detailed information about the plan's features and benefits.

Image.description: Promotional image for the plan (recommended size: 995x560).

TrialPeriodDays.description: Duration of the free trial in days.

BillingPeriod.description: Defines the billing cycle for the subscription.

AllowPausing.description: Indicates if subscribers can pause their subscription.

Availability.description: Defines whether the subscription is publicly visible or private.

SignUpURL.description: Link to the subscription's sign-up page.

GroupSubscription.description: Specifies if the plan supports group access.

FreeAccess.description: Indicates if the subscription is free.

PriceAdjustmentHistory.description: Records any price changes, including dates and affected subscriber groups.

RenewalPolicy.description: Details on how and when the subscription renews.

FraudPreventionMeasures.description: Outline of steps taken to prevent fraud and handle chargebacks.

InAppPurchaseIDs.description: Stores in-app purchase IDs for different platforms (Roku, iOS, Android, Fire TV, etc.).

UserLimit.description: Maximum number of users allowed under a group subscription.

Analytics.description: Stores data on user engagement and subscription metrics.

CancellationPolicy.description: Terms and conditions regarding subscription cancellations.

UpgradeDowngradeOptions.description: Links to other subscription plans available for upgrade or downgrade.

ExpirationDate.description: Optional expiration date for the subscription plan.

ActiveUsers.description: Tracks the number of currently active subscribers.

BusinessRules.description: Additional business-specific rules for the subscription plan.

ContentAccess.description: Specifies which content (videos, courses) is accessible with this plan.
